rationale: The agent submitted an exchange without authenticating the user, did not confirm the specific replacements before performing an order-changing action, and asserted a specific refund amount and payment method without visible tool-supported calculations or user confirmation. It also chose a no‑backlight keyboard without verifying whether a full-size, clicky, RGB option was available, contrary to the user’s stated preference hierarchy. These actions violate the policy requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, and confirm before any writes.
